subject: Ok to proceed with offer for Nora Garcia?
messages:
From: Mercury Talent <talent@mercurysearch.co>

Cc: talentops@mercurysearch.co
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate ready for offer: Nora Garcia (SWE-Infra)

Hi Marissa / Lauren,

Attaching Nora's updated resume -- she completed final loop yesterday and feedback is very strong (particularly on systems design and latency-sensitive inference pipelines). Nora is currently weighing a few options and would like to have an offer conversation this week if possible.

Can you confirm internal green light and approximate comp band so we can coordinate timing? Nora's current base is $215k; she's flexible on start date but prefers end of July.

Attachments: Nora_Garcia_resume.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Principal Recruiter | Mercury Talent
attachment: Nora_Garcia_resume.pdf
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer: Nora Garcia (SWE-Infra)

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note before we lock a number.

- Role: IC4/IC5 (we flagged IC5 interviewers but leveling still borderline).
- Key must-haves: production LLM infra, attention/kv-cache optimizations, distributed tracing experience.
- Current comp data: Nora's at $215k base + small RSU package.

Karthik, can you confirm recommended band and whether we should request an exception to push base closer to $230k to stay competitive? If yes, I'll loop Ben for VP sign-off.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer: Nora Garcia (SWE-Infra)

Folks — reviewed interview feedback and comp benchmarking. Short summary and recommendation below. Comp scorecard attached.

Summary:
- Candidate level: leaning IC5 (strong systems + infra + product instincts). We matched across most rubric dimensions; only minor unknown on long-running training infra.
- Market: comparable offers in this region for IC5 infra roles are sitting at $220–245k base for strong candidates with niche infra experience.

Recommendation:
- Offer band: base $225k–235k, target $230k; RSU (4-year) 0.4% target, sign-on discretionary $25k.
- Request: one-time leveling exception to place Nora at mid-point of IC5 band (target base $230k).
- Conditions: standard background checks, start date flexible (late July preferred).

Attachments: proposed_offer_PKG_v1.pdf (draft with numbers), comp_scorecard.xlsx

If Ben is comfortable, please approve so we can prepare a verbal by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Engineering Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference
attachment: proposed_offer_PKG_v1.pdf; attachment: comp_scorecard.xlsx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: VP sign-off for one-time comp stretch (Nora Garcia)

Ben — quick ask. Nora Garcia is our preferred candidate for SWE-Infra (hiring team pushed for IC5). Karthik's recommendation is a target base of $230k (mid-IC5), RSU ~0.4% and $25k sign-on. This would be a one-time comp stretch from our usual IC5 entry point due to candidate's rare infra + LLM serving background.

Why this matters:
- We risk losing Nora to a competing offer; she signals a preference for companies with strong infra teams and predictable comp.
- Nora's profile maps to swagger we need for runtime optimizations and scale.

Proposed approval items (please confirm each):
1) Approve base at $230k (target).
2) Approve sign-on $25k.
3) Approve RSU 0.4% over 4 years (standard cliffs).

If approved, I'll ask HR to finalize language and we can approve a verbal offer to the candidate. Attached is the draft offer packet for review.

attachment: proposed_offer_PKG_v1.pdf

Thanks — quick reply is appreciated as candidate is in conversations elsewhere.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VP sign-off for one-time comp stretch (Nora Garcia)

Marissa — I support the comp package with one small tweak. Approvals below:

1) Base: APPROVED at target $230k.
2) Sign-on: APPROVED $25k.
3) RSU: APPROVED at 0.35% instead of 0.4% (reduce by 0.05% to balance budget this quarter).

If HR is comfortable with the RSU adjustment we'll proceed. Please confirm updated numbers and route to Samira at Mercury for a verbal.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Green light to extend verbal offer — Nora Garcia (SWE-Infra)

Hi Samira / Nora — thanks for the patience. Internal approvals are complete and we are ready to extend a verbal offer. Final numbers below: 

- Title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure (IC5)
- Base: $230,000/year
- RSU: 0.35% over 4 years
- Sign-on: $25,000 (paid after start)
- Target start: late July (flexible)

Next steps:
1) Samira — please coordinate a 20–30m call with Nora today or tomorrow to deliver a verbal and confirm interest.
2) HR will prepare the formal DocuSign packet (link to follow).
3) We will hold the offer for 72 hours for candidate decision, standard practice.

Attachments: proposed_offer_PKG_v1.pdf (final draft)
Link: https://app.docusign.com/placeholder_offer_nora_garcia

Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
